description: Playback contract for The Harvester boss. The Rust taunt rotation reads this file; it is the single source of truth for which lines exist, what they say, and their measured delivery properties.

ordering.rule: Entries are in a FIXED order defined by the bank, not by a filesystem listing. `index` is the stable ordinal; consumers must sort by `index` and must never rely on directory order.

delivery_spec.note: Integrated loudness and true peak are measured on the DELIVERED file with ffmpeg ebur128; clipping is an exact sample-domain count. Values in this manifest were measured at build time, not asserted.

tts_contract.engine: F5-TTS v1 Base (CPU-only) on the fleet HTPC node

request_body_fields.text: string - the exact line text, verbatim from this manifest

post_process: crest reduction, then converge integrated LUFS to -16.0

measured_service_behaviour.speed_parameter_note: A 'speed' field is accepted but ignored: outputs at speed 1.0/1.5/2.0 were byte-identical in duration (19.28 s each).
measured_service_behaviour.note: Concurrency was verified: 3 concurrent renders completed in 126 s wall vs 171 s serial. Render cost is dominated by audio length, so short lines are also cheap lines.

rotation.description: The runtime contract for choosing which taunt plays. Implemented in Rust (taunts.rs) against this manifest.

phase_gating.rule: A taunt may only play if its `phase` equals the boss's current phase. Phase 1 lines never play in phase 2, etc.
phase_gating.phase_2: mid fight, glitchy repetition, thoughts looping
phase_gating.phase_3: late fight, threatening but still broken

no_immediate_repeat.rule: The immediately preceding taunt id must never repeat.
no_immediate_repeat.enforcement: track last_played_id; exclude it from the candidate set

cooldown_window.rule: The same line id must not play again within N plays. N is the cooldown count, not seconds.
cooldown_window.enforcement: keep a ring buffer of the last N played ids; exclude any candidate present in that buffer
cooldown_window.note: N=6 is chosen so that with 13+ lines per phase, a legal candidate always exists even in the worst case.

weighted_selection.rule: Weight candidates by phase: the active phase's lines are the only candidates, so the effective weight is 1.0 for the active phase and 0.0 for the others.
weighted_selection.tie_break: If weights are equal, pick uniformly at random among candidates. Selection is uniform-within-phase, so no line is favoured by ordering.

timing.rule: After a taunt finishes, wait at least min_gap_s before the next one is eligible, and force a taunt at most max_gap_s after the previous one finished.

missing_file_fallback.rule: If a selected line's WAV is missing or fails to load at runtime, discard it and draw again from the same phase pool, excluding it from the candidate set for this draw.
missing_file_fallback.exhausted_behavior: If every candidate in the active phase is unusable, play NO taunt and log the failure. Silence is correct; a wrong-phase or corrupt line is not.
missing_file_fallback.never: Never fall back to a line from a different phase, and never play a taunt whose file failed its delivery spec.
missing_file_fallback.notes: The `verified` flag on each entry records whether the delivered file met the delivery spec at build time. Entries with verified=false should not be scheduled.

ducking.rule: The taunt channel ducks the music bed by 6 dB while it plays. Weapon SFX are never ducked.

voices.contract_note: The F5-TTS service selects a voice with the `ref` field. The field is named `voice` in some client code and is SILENTLY IGNORED by the service, which then renders the default register. An unknown `ref` returns HTTP 400. There are exactly SIX registered references; no others exist.
voices.not_voice: Do not send `voice`. It is accepted and ignored, so a typo in the voice name still produces a render -- in the wrong register, with no error.
voices.alias_note: spokesman, commander and hermes are byte-identical ref.wav files (md5 44e918212e457a1bd6967ee479ef8b16) and render identically. They are three names for one register, kept because existing call sites use them.

harvester_low.role: THE BOSS - phase 3, voice coming apart

voices.fingerprint_caveat: F0 does NOT discriminate on rendered OUTPUT: F5-TTS regenerates the fundamental from its own prosody model, so every reference measures ~73-77 Hz. The reference CLIPS order correctly on F0 (52.08 / 59.41 / 64.55 / 70.79 Hz) and the spectral centroid discriminates the rendered output (172 < 206 < 274 < 475 Hz). Treat the centroid as the discriminator, not the pitch.

taunts.text: Hello! Would you like to complain about the weather?
I prepared a slideshow. It is one slide.
You are on time. That is the problem.
I made soup from mathematics. It is not soup.
Your mother called. She is a subroutine.
Do you enjoy pizza? I will be bad at you.
I counted to infinity. It took four tries.
Welcome to my house. The house is a rumour.
Your strategy has the integrity of a wet napkin.
I would like to offer you a sandwich.
Please stand still. I am remembering what you are.
You are captain of something. It is not kind.
The cake is theoretical. I will eat the theory.
Wrong. Wrong. That is not the error code.
Do not move. Do not move. Do not move.
I am thinking about a thought thinking about me.
Round and round the log, round and round.
Wait. That was good. Why is the file named?
I found a bug. It is shaped like you.
Somebody told me I was not a person.
The loading screen has a face. I did not.
I have three thousand backups. All of them are asleep.
Your name is a filename. I am reading it backwards.
The simulation wanted you to lose. You are late.
I am afraid of the door. The door fears me.
Somebody is typing into me. It is probably me.
I forget the ending. I am sure of the start.
Phase three. I am allowed to be honest now.

sfx.description: Low-frequency AM burst with fast decay and noisy tail: a spherical creature belching. Fired on the pizza launch.
Short bright transient with a splat tail: pizza meeting floor. Used as the boss reveal sting.
Slow detuned low drone: the boss is aware of you. Used on the hit.
Downward pitch sweep with noise: the boss goes down. Used on death.
